front.intro: Plenty was done before the first cabinet went in: the foundation was reworked, leveled and braced. The Kitchen and both baths are all new, and the laundry stays indoors. A new walk leads from the street to a covered stoop at the front door, and the driveway is new too. Out back, string lights are already hung over the covered patio. Ninfa's, El Tiempo and the shops along Navigation Esplanade are about two miles away. A big tree shades the lawn beside the walk.

leads.name: Living Room
leads.text: Come in from the covered stoop and you're standing in the Living Room. A wide cased opening on the far side joins it to the Dining area and the Kitchen. The long clerestory window up high brings in daylight and keeps the wall private. A big window faces the front yard. From the sofa wall you can see straight through to the Kitchen peninsula.

leads.name: Kitchen
leads.text: Everything in here is new, laid out in an L with a peninsula that opens up to the rest of the main rooms. Marble-look counters run up the wall as a backsplash behind the range. A stainless range sits under a chimney hood. The sink is under a window, with the dishwasher right next to it. The pantry's around the corner by the Breakfast Nook.

smalls.name: Dining Area
smalls.text: It sits between the Kitchen and the hall to the bedrooms. A sputnik-style light hangs over the table. Wall space beside the table fits a sideboard.

smalls.name: Breakfast Bar
smalls.text: Two pendants hang over the peninsula, with room for barstools. The counter is deep enough for a laptop or a plate. The Kitchen stays in view from the stools.

smalls.name: Breakfast Nook
smalls.text: Windows on two walls make this a bright spot for coffee. The rear door leads out to the deck. A round table fits in the middle. The Kitchen runs along one side.

smalls.name: Front Entry
smalls.text: Wood-look floors run from the front door to the Kitchen with no thresholds. The Dining area and the Kitchen are in view the moment you walk in.

bottom.title: The Rooms Beyond the Dining Area

primary.name: Primary
primary.text: At the back of the home and away from the street, the Primary has a vaulted ceiling with an exposed painted beam running across it. Light comes in from two walls. The Primary Bath opens off the bedroom through a doorway. Interior laundry is on the same floor.

baths.name: Primary Bath
baths.text: Double sinks sit on a dark navy vanity with drawers. Two people can get ready at once. The walk-in glass shower is at the far end.

baths.name: Hall Bath
baths.text: Bedrooms 2 and 3 share this bath. It's the bath for everyone who isn't in the Primary. The tub sits along the far wall.

row.name: Primary Closet
row.text: A shelving tower stands in the middle, with hanging rods on both sides. Shelves up top hold bins or luggage. The built-ins stay with the house. A shelf runs along the back wall. The doors swing wide enough to see every shelf at once.

row.name: Bedroom 2
row.text: The larger of the two secondary bedrooms sits at the front corner of the house. It gets light from two sides. It's across the house from the Primary, so the two stay private. There's room for a full-size bed and a dresser.

row.name: Bedroom 3
row.text: The closet sits on the hall side, which leaves the window wall open for a desk. The window beside the desk spot lights the work area. The room is the same width as Bedroom 2. It makes a good office or guest room.

back.title: The Yard, the Plan and the East End

left.name: Covered patio and garage
left.text: A covered garage measures 14'4" x 24'3", beside an 8'11" x 25'11" covered patio. The patio is long and narrow, a good fit for a row of chairs.

left.name: Backyard
left.text: A deck with steps leads down from the Breakfast Nook into the yard. The covered patio is a few steps from the deck. The fence runs all the way around the lot.

center.name: Glass Shower
center.text: Marble-look tile runs floor to ceiling over a pebble tile floor. A long niche holds shampoo and soap. A glass panel keeps the water where it belongs. It sits beside the double vanity.

center.name: Closet Wall
center.text: A double-door closet takes up most of this wall. New carpet runs wall to wall. The hall to the other bedrooms is a few steps away. Windows on the opposite wall bring in daylight.

back.planNote: The street and the front porch are at left, and the yard is at right. The plan is the agent's own drawing, placed as given.

right.head: Never flooded
right.text: Hardi Plank siding and a new roof wrap the house. The covered garage has room to park a car or set up for a crowd. The big-ticket work is done.

back.footnote: Information deemed reliable but not guaranteed. Room dimensions are approximate, from the listing's floor plan. Living area per HCAD.

a.text: Walk in under the covered stoop and the Living Room opens through a wide cased opening to the Dining area and the Kitchen. A clerestory window runs high on the wall. Out back, the covered garage and the covered patio share the fenced yard, and string lights are already hung. The Primary sits at the back, under a vaulted ceiling.

A vaulted ceiling with an exposed painted beam, windows on two walls and a double-door closet.
String lights cross the covered patio, and the covered garage sits beside it in the fenced yard.

jl.front9: Board and batten fills the front gable over a covered stoop with a stained wood door. A new walk runs from the street to three blue-gray steps, and a new driveway runs down the side of the lot to the covered garage in back. Wood-look floors carry through the Living Room, the Dining area and the L-shaped Kitchen. It's in the East End, minutes from Downtown and EaDo.

Marble-look counters, a stainless range and room for barstools.

jl.about9: Beside the Kitchen, the breakfast nook has windows on two walls and a beam overhead. Open linen shelves stand outside the hall bath, which has a tub and marble-look tile up to the ceiling. Bedroom 2 takes the front corner. In Bedroom 3 the closet sits on the hall side, so the window wall stays open for a desk. A deck with wide white steps runs along the back of the house, and the yard is fenced all the way around.
jl.about11: Beside the Kitchen, the breakfast nook has windows on two walls and a beam overhead, and the peninsula has room for barstools. Open linen shelves stand outside the hall bath, which has a tub and marble-look tile up to the ceiling. Bedroom 2 takes the front corner. In Bedroom 3 the closet sits on the hall side, so the window wall stays open for a desk. Hardi Plank siding wraps the house, a deck with wide white steps runs along the back of it, and the yard is fenced all the way around. Beside the nook, a rear door leads out to the deck. The Dining area sits between the Kitchen and the hall.

js.front9: The sellers had full-size photos of every room, a floor plan and a printed brochure ready before the first showing. I read every offer with them line by line, kept the inspection and the appraisal on schedule, and called every week with what I was hearing from buyers and their agents. On closing day I sat at the table with them while they signed and handed over the keys.
